# Vendored: cantojam

`cantojam.js` and `data.js` are copied unchanged from
[candpixie/cantojam](https://github.com/candpixie/cantojam) `web/`
(commit b33fe77). To update, copy both files again. Do not edit them here.

- `cantojam.js`: MIT.
- `data.js`: derived from Jason Lee, *A Corpus of Cantonese Popular Music,
  2000-2020* (https://github.com/jasonleeubc/Cantopop-corpus), CC BY 4.0.
  The `COLLOQUIAL` table inside it is MIT.
- `lexicon.js`: a stub written for Moodence (see the comment inside).
